entities_reviewed.cascading_rules: Deleting a tenant cascades to all members, departments, documents, assistants, and conversations via foreign keys.
Document deletion cascades to document_versions, document_chunks, and chunk_embeddings in PostgreSQL; storage provider deletes raw files.

entities_reviewed.dimension_handling: pgvector isolates vector columns by dimension; Qdrant isolates collections by dimension (e.g. mmaip_chunks_384d, mmaip_chunks_1536d); reindexing uses separate version collections.

entities_reviewed.cascading_rules: Deleting a conversation cascades to messages and message_citations in PostgreSQL.

entities_reviewed.retention: Audit records have no update/delete methods in repository; protected against tenant tampering.
